data.name: Bot or Brush
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Bot or Brush is an online party game where you and your friends try to answer one simple question:

Was this drawing made by a human... or by AI?

Each round, a predefined subject is chosen, such as Cat, Dog, House, Book, and more. For each image, the creator is either a real player or an AI — and everyone must guess which one it is.

Some drawings are clever. Some are chaotic. Some look suspiciously perfect. And some might make you question both your friends’ artistic skills and the AI’s sense of style.

Guess Who Made It

Look closely, compare the artwork, and trust your instincts. Was that strange little dog drawn by your friend, or did an AI create it? Vote on whether each drawing was made by a human or by AI, then see who can spot the difference.

Play Online With Friends

Bot or Brush is designed for private online sessions with friends. Create a lobby, invite your group, and play together from anywhere.

  • Online multiplayer for up to 8 players

  • Private friend lobbies

  • No single-player mode

  • Built for party-game chaos, debates, and laughs

No Drawing Skill Required

You do not need to be good at drawing to have fun. In fact, bad drawings might be the perfect disguise. Whether you are an artist, a doodler, or someone who should probably not be trusted with a digital brush, every round gives you a chance to fool your friends.

Features

  • Draw from simple predefined subjects like Cat, Dog, House, Book, and more

  • Guess whether each image was made by a player or generated by AI

  • Play online with up to 8 friends

  • Create private lobbies for your group

  • Compare drawings, vote, debate, and laugh at the results

  • A party game where creativity, suspicion, and terrible art all matter
